title: [2.4.0](https://github.com/openbudgetfun/openbudget/releases/tag/v2.4.0) (2026-11-05)
summary: A small release with two things worth opening.

entries.summary: See what changed after each update
entries.details_markdown:
OpenBudget now opens its release notes once after an update.

- **Every update.** Read what changed without leaving the app.
- **On your terms.** Open the notes again from Settings whenever you like.

Nothing to learn, nothing to configure.
Notes keep their paragraphs and lists, so a long note is still easy to scan.
